requirements.rationale: PreJoinPreview component correctly initializes media state to disabled (requestCamera=false, requestMicrophone=false) and strictly enforces that camera and microphone are only enabled when permission status is GRANTED, devices are available, and access has been explicitly requested.
PreJoinPreview component does not expose role as a component prop and hardcodes internal state to BROADCASTER, preventing caller from supplying VIEWER role to verify viewer muting.

PreJoinPreview evaluates isReadyToJoin purely based on displayName trimming and length constraint (displayName.trim().length > 0 and displayName.trim().length <= 50) without requiring active media tracks, keeping Join disabled until a valid name is entered.
Component generates a random UUID (crypto.randomUUID()) for participantKey instead of accepting and preserving command.participantKey from input command props.
cameraEnabled is defined as (!isViewer and requestCamera and cameraAvailable and cameraPermission is GRANTED), ensuring camera remains disabled whenever permission is DENIED or not GRANTED.

microphoneEnabled is defined as (!isViewer and requestMicrophone and microphoneAvailable and microphonePermission is GRANTED), ensuring microphone remains disabled whenever permission is DENIED or not GRANTED.
Component preview state is strictly local client React state; no backend API mutations or database calls occur during preview review.
